system.description:
Usage held or placed; Weight 4 lbs.

Four tiny silver doors are worked into the sides of this black iron censer. Whenever a spirit enters the smoke, one of them appears briefly to close.

The censer can burn any ordinary incense. While incense burns within it, willing creatures within 20 feet gain a +1-status bonus to saving throws against possession and effects with the Soul trait. A possessing entity does not receive this benefit through its host.

You also gain the Reveal the Unseen ability:

Reveal the Unseen:

Activate Command (1 AP)

Frequency 1/day

Requirement Incense is currently burning

For 1-minute, disembodied spirits and incorporeal Undead within the smoke become faintly outlined and may be perceived sufficiently clearly to determine their location. This does not remove Incorporeal, reveal allegiance or allow mundane weapons to affect them.

On the sheet: an ally aura (20 feet): +1 status to saves against possession and Soul effects — meant for while the incense burns. Use is Reveal the Unseen (1/day): a minute's outline of spirits in the smoke.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
